input.script:
export const meta = {
  name: 'read-probe',
  description: 'Read-only probe: two parallel agents read alpha.txt and beta.txt',
  phases: [{ title: 'read', detail: 'two parallel Read-only agents' }],
}
phase('read')
const cwd = '/tmp/michi-workflow-probe'
const res = await parallel([
  () => agent(`Use only the Read tool to read ${cwd}/alpha.txt. Reply with the ALPHA_MARKER value exactly as found.`, {label: 'alpha', phase: 'read'}),
  () => agent(`Use only the Read tool to read ${cwd}/beta.txt. Reply with the BETA_MARKER value exactly as found.`, {label: 'beta', phase: 'read'}),
])
return res

description: Read-only probe: two parallel agents read alpha.txt and beta.txt
